metrics.label: Cash balance
metrics.definition: Cash and cash equivalents from the latest verified financial-position source.

metrics.label: Working capital
metrics.definition: Current assets less current liabilities from the same financial-position snapshot.

metrics.label: Current ratio
metrics.definition: Current assets divided by current liabilities from one reconciled financial-position snapshot.

metrics.label: Net profit
metrics.definition: Revenue less all reported expenses for the latest complete Profit and Loss period.

metrics.label: Monthly inflows
metrics.definition: Positive bank and transaction movements in the latest available calendar month.

metrics.label: Monthly outflows
metrics.definition: Absolute value of negative bank and transaction movements in the latest available calendar month.

metrics.label: Overdue invoice exposure
metrics.definition: Open invoices whose due date is before the current date.

metrics.label: Taxable profit estimate
metrics.definition: Posted-ledger taxable basis where complete, otherwise the latest Profit and Loss snapshot clearly marked provisional.

metrics.label: Marketing ROAS
metrics.definition: Attributed revenue divided by verified marketing spend. Demonstration values must never be presented as actual.

metrics.label: Data trust score
metrics.definition: Weighted score from setup coverage, classification integrity, metric reconciliation, freshness and unresolved validation checks.
